info.title: Personal Trainer Platform API
info.description: Multi-tenant business management and progress tracking. Errors: { error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }.

acceptTerms.description: Must be true: accepts the current terms and privacy policy.

refreshToken.description: Native clients send the refresh token here; web clients use the cookie.

code.description: 6-digit authenticator code or a recovery code (xxxxx-xxxxx)

phone.description: E.164 format. null removes the number.

slug.description: URL address. Generated from the name when omitted (required for non-Latin names).

rank.description: Must be below your own role rank.

templateRoleId.description: Copy grants from this role when `grants` is omitted.

roleId.description: Role to grant on acceptance (must be below your own rank).

fullName.description: Prefilled display name used in the e-mail.

assignToMembershipId.description: Practitioner membership to assign the new member to on acceptance. Defaults to you when your member access is limited to assigned participants.

practitionerMembershipId.description: Membership of the trainer / teacher / coach.

participantMembershipId.description: Membership of the client / student / member.

organizationId.description: Omit for your default across organizations.

assigneeMembershipIds.description: Membership ids. Defaults to yourself when omitted and no group is given.

groupIds.description: Every active member of these groups is assigned individually.

version.description: The version you read. A mismatch means someone else changed the task (409).

status.description: CANCELLED cancels; OPEN reopens (status is re-derived from assignees).

higherIsBetter.description: true = increases are good (strength), false = decreases are good (weight loss), omit = neutral.

recordedAt.description: When it was measured. Defaults to now; cannot be in the future.

sizeBytes.description: Exact size in bytes; the signed upload URL accepts nothing else.

membershipId.description: Membership id of the person to talk to (see GET /messaging/contacts).

body.description: Plain text. Required unless files are attached.

fileIds.description: Ids of your own uploaded, non-sensitive files.

messageId.description: Read up to and including this message. Omit to read everything.

note.description: What happened, in your words. Optional.

outcome.description: DISMISSED: nothing to act on. ACTIONED: the moderator dealt with it (e.g. suspended the sender).

videoUrl.description: https link to a demonstration video (hosted elsewhere).

startingWeightKg.description: Recorded once as the first weight measurement ("starting weight").

fromVersionId.description: Copy this version into the new draft. Defaults to the current published version.

supersetGroup.description: Exercises sharing a number are performed back to back.

days.description: Plan days in order (day 1 first); at most seven.

versionId.description: A published version of the plan. Defaults to the current one.

groupIds.description: Every active member of these groups that you may assign to.

startDate.description: First day, in the organization's time zone. Not in the past.

weeklySchedule.description: Plan day number → ISO weekday (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday). Each day on its own weekday.

scheduledDate.description: Defaults to today (organization time zone); never in the future.

logDate.description: Defaults to today; never in the future.

measurements.description: Measurement key → value, e.g. { "weight_kg": 82.4 }. null removes a value.

checkinId.description: Required for WEEKLY photos: the draft check-in they belong to.

takenOn.description: Defaults to today; never in the future.

location.description: A place or a meeting link.

sessionId.description: The session this note belongs to (optional).

visibility.description: PRIVATE: only you (and owners who hold the sensitive permission). SHARED: the client sees it too.

questions.description: Up to 20 questions: { id, kind: SCALE | YESNO | TEXT, label: { en, ar } }.

cadenceDays.description: Ask again this many days after each completion (7 to 365). Omit for a single request.

answers.description: Answers by question id: a number 1 to 10, true/false, or text.

url.description: An http(s) link. Give a link, a file, or both.

fileId.description: Id of your own finished, non-sensitive upload.

clientMembershipId.description: Share with one client. Omit to share with every client assigned to you.
